articles.abstract_en: This paper regards symmetry in games with more than two players. It is often said that a two-player game is symmetric if it looks the same to both players. However, there are n-player games, such as Salop's circle model, that seem intuitively to look the same to all players, but do not meet the common definition of a symmetric n-player game. This paper proposes a more general symmetry condition that is satisfied by such models. Previous authors have established that games which are symmetric in the common sense have a number of useful properties relating to equilibrium characterization and comparative statics. With few exceptions, those properties continue to hold in the richer class of games that meet the symmetry condition proposed here.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文关注多于两个参与人的博弈中的对称性。通常认为，如果一个两人博弈对两个参与人来说看起来相同，那么它就是对称的。然而，有些n人博弈，如萨洛普的圆形模型，直觉上对所有参与人看起来相同，但并不满足对称n人博弈的常见定义。本文提出了一个更一般的对称性条件，这类模型满足该条件。先前的作者已经证明，在通常意义上对称的博弈具有一些与均衡刻画和比较静态相关的有用性质。除少数例外，这些性质在满足本文提出的对称性条件的更丰富的博弈类中仍然成立。

articles.title_cn: 内生欺骗成本下的沟通
articles.abstract_en: We study how the suspicion that communicated information might be deceptive affects the nature of what can be communicated in a sender-receiver game. Sender is said to deceive Receiver if she sends a message that induces a belief that is different from the belief that should have been induced in the realized state. Deception is costly to Sender and the cost is endogenous: it is increasing in the distance between the induced belief and the belief that should have been induced. A message function that induces Sender to engage in deception is not credible and cannot be part of an equilibrium. We study credible communication with state-dependent and state-independent Sender's preferences. The cost of deception parametrizes the sender's ability to commit to her strategy. Through varying this cost, our model spans the range from cheap talk, or no commitment (Crawford and Sobel, 1982) to full commitment (Kamenica and Gentzkow, 2011).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在发送者-接收者博弈中，对沟通信息可能具有欺骗性的怀疑如何影响可沟通内容的性质。如果发送者发送的消息诱导的信念与在实现状态下本应诱导的信念不同，则称发送者欺骗了接收者。欺骗对发送者而言是有成本的，且该成本是内生的：它随诱导信念与本应诱导信念之间的距离递增。诱导发送者进行欺骗的消息函数是不可信的，不能成为均衡的一部分。我们研究了在发送者偏好依赖于状态和不依赖于状态的情况下的可信沟通。欺骗成本参数化了发送者对其策略的承诺能力。通过改变这一成本，我们的模型涵盖了从廉价交谈或无承诺（Crawford和Sobel，1982）到完全承诺（Kamenica和Gentzkow，2011）的范围。

articles.title_en: Comment on “A theoretical foundation of ambiguity measurement” [J. Econ. Theory 187 (2020) 105001]
articles.title_cn: 对“模糊度量的理论基础”一文的评论 [J. Econ. Theory 187 (2020) 105001]
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study asymptotic expansions for distorted probabilities under ambiguity, revisiting the framework and analysis of Izhakian (2020b). We argue that the first order terms in these expansions need to be corrected and provide alternatives. We also revisit later results in this paper on the separation of ambiguity and ambiguity attitudes. We argue that a crucial lemma is flawed implying that Izhakian's ambiguity measure ℧2 is not an equivalent way of representing the preferences it is supposed to represent.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了模糊下扭曲概率的渐近展开，重新审视了Izhakian (2020b)的框架和分析。我们认为这些展开中的一阶项需要修正，并提供了替代方案。我们还重新审视了本文中关于模糊与模糊态度分离的后续结果。我们认为一个关键引理存在缺陷，这意味着Izhakian的模糊度量℧2并不是其所声称要表示的偏好的等价表示方式。

articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel dynamic bargaining game where every party is proposing only its own contribution, before all pledges must be unanimously approved. I show that, with uncertain tolerance for delay, each equilibrium pledge maximizes an asymmetric Nash product. The weights on others' payoffs increase in the uncertainty, but decrease in the correlation of the shocks. The weights vary pledge to pledge, and this implies that the outcome is generically inefficient. The Nash demand game and its mapping to the Nash bargaining solution follow as a limiting case. The model sheds light on the Paris climate change agreement, but it also applies to negotiations between policymakers or business partners that have differentiated responsibilities or expertise.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的动态谈判博弈，其中每一方仅提出自己的贡献，之后所有承诺必须获得一致通过。我证明，在对延迟的容忍度不确定的情况下，每个均衡承诺最大化一个不对称的纳什积。他人收益的权重随不确定性增加而增加，但随冲击的相关性增加而减少。权重因承诺而异，这意味着结果通常是低效的。纳什需求博弈及其与纳什谈判解的映射作为一个极限情形出现。该模型揭示了巴黎气候变化协议，但也适用于具有不同责任或专长的政策制定者或商业伙伴之间的谈判。

articles.abstract_en: We study how learning and influence co-evolve in a social network by extending the classical model of DeGroot (1974) in two fundamental ways:
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过以两种基本方式扩展DeGroot（1974）的经典模型，研究社会网络中学习与影响如何共同演化：

articles.title_cn: 关于完美成对稳定网络
articles.abstract_en: We extend standard tools from equilibrium refinement theory in non-cooperative games to a cooperative framework of network formation. First, we introduce the new concept of perfect pairwise stability. It transposes the idea of “trembling hand” perfection to network formation theory and strictly refines the pairwise stability concept of Jackson and Wolinsky (1996). Second, we study basic properties of perfect pairwise stability: existence, admissibility and perturbation. We further show that our concept is distinct from the concept of strongly stable networks introduced by Jackson and Van den Nouweland (2005), and perfect Nash equilibria of the Myerson network formation game studied by Calvó-Armengol and İlkılıç (2009). Finally, we apply perfect pairwise stability to sequential network formation and prove that it enables a refinement of sequential pairwise stability, a natural analogue of subgame perfection in a setting with cooperative, pairwise link formation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将非合作博弈中均衡精炼理论的标准工具扩展到网络形成的合作框架中。首先，我们引入了完美成对稳定性的新概念。它将“颤抖手”完美性的思想转置到网络形成理论中，并严格精炼了Jackson和Wolinsky（1996）的成对稳定性概念。其次，我们研究了完美成对稳定性的基本性质：存在性、可接受性和扰动性。我们进一步表明，我们的概念不同于Jackson和Van den Nouweland（2005）引入的强稳定网络概念，也不同于Calvó-Armengol和İlkılıç（2009）研究的Myerson网络形成博弈中的完美纳什均衡。最后，我们将完美成对稳定性应用于序贯网络形成，并证明它能够精炼序贯成对稳定性，这是在具有合作性、成对链接形成的环境中子博弈完美性的自然类比。

articles.title_en: Randomization is optimal in the robust principal-agent problem
articles.title_cn: 随机化在稳健委托-代理问题中是最优的
articles.abstract_en: A principal contracts with an agent, who takes a hidden action. The principal does not know all of the actions the agent can take and evaluates her payoff from any contract according to its worst-case performance. Carroll (2015) showed that there exists a linear contract that is optimal within the class of deterministic contracts. This paper shows that, whenever there is an optimal linear contract with non-zero slope, the principal can strictly increase her payoff by randomizing over deterministic, linear contracts. Hence, if the principal believes that randomization can alleviate her ambiguity aversion, then restricting attention to the study of deterministic contracts is with loss of generality.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人（principal）与代理人（agent）签订契约，代理人采取隐藏行动。委托人并不知晓代理人可能采取的所有行动，并根据任何契约的最坏情况表现来评估其收益。Carroll（2015）证明了在确定性契约类别中存在一个最优的线性契约。本文表明，只要存在一个斜率非零的最优线性契约，委托人就可以通过对确定性线性契约进行随机化来严格提高其收益。因此，如果委托人相信随机化能够缓解其模糊厌恶，那么将注意力限制在确定性契约的研究上就会丧失一般性。

articles.title_en: Information design through scarcity and social learning
articles.title_cn: 通过稀缺性和社会学习进行信息设计
articles.abstract_en: We show that a firm may benefit from strategically creating scarcity for its product, in order to trigger herding behaviour from consumers in situations where such behaviour is otherwise unlikely. We consider a setting with social learning, where consumers observe sales from previous cohorts and update beliefs about product quality before making their purchase. Imposing a capacity constraint directly limits sales but also makes information coarser for consumers, who react favourably to a sell-out because they infer only that demand must exceed capacity. Consumer learning is then limited even with large cohorts and unbounded private signals, because the firm acts strategically to influence the consumers' learning environment. Our results suggest that in suitable environments capacity constraints can serve as a useful tool to implement optimal information design in practice: if private signals are not too precise and capacity can be changed over time, then in large markets the firm's optimal choice of capacity delivers the same expected sales as the Bayesian persuasion solution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，企业可能通过战略性地制造产品稀缺性而受益，以在消费者行为通常不太可能发生从众行为的情况下触发从众行为。我们考虑一个具有社会学习的设定，其中消费者观察前几批次的销售情况，并在购买前更新对产品质量的信念。施加产能约束直接限制了销售，但也使消费者的信息变得粗糙，消费者对售罄反应积极，因为他们仅推断需求必定超过产能。即使有大批次和无界私人信号，消费者学习也是有限的，因为企业战略性地行动以影响消费者的学习环境。我们的结果表明，在合适的环境中，产能约束可以作为实践中实施最优信息设计的有用工具：如果私人信号不是太精确且产能可以随时间变化，那么在大型市场中，企业的最优产能选择带来的预期销售与贝叶斯说服解决方案相同。

articles.abstract_en: We study dynamic task allocation when providers' expertise evolves endogenously through training. We characterize optimal assignment protocols and compare them to discretionary procedures, where it is the clients who select their service providers. Our results indicate that welfare gains from centralization are greater when tasks arrive more rapidly, and when training technologies improve. Monitoring seniors' backlog of clients always increases welfare but may decrease training. Methodologically, we explore a matching setting with endogenous types, and illustrate useful adaptations of queueing theory techniques for such environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当服务提供者的专业知识通过培训内生演化时的动态任务分配问题。我们刻画了最优分配协议，并将其与由客户自行选择服务提供者的自由裁量程序进行比较。我们的结果表明，当任务到达更频繁以及培训技术改进时，集中化带来的福利收益更大。监控资深服务提供者的客户积压情况总是能提高福利，但可能减少培训。在方法论上，我们探索了一个具有内生类型的匹配设定，并展示了排队论技术在此类环境中的有用改编。

articles.title_en: Loss aversion in strategy-proof school-choice mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 策略证明学校选择机制中的损失厌恶
articles.abstract_en: Evidence suggests that participants in strategy-proof matching mechanisms play dominated strategies. To explain the data, we introduce expectation-based loss aversion into a school-choice setting and characterize choice-acclimating personal equilibria. We find that non-truthful preference submissions can be strictly optimal if and only if they are top-rank monotone. In equilibrium, inefficiency or justified envy may arise in seemingly stable or efficient mechanisms. Specifically, students who are more loss averse or less confident than their peers obtain suboptimal allocations.
articles.abstract_cn: 有证据表明，参与策略证明匹配机制的参与者会采取被支配策略。为解释这些数据，我们将基于期望的损失厌恶引入学校选择环境，并刻画了适应选择的个人均衡。我们发现，非真实偏好提交严格最优当且仅当它们是顶级排名单调的。在均衡中，看似稳定或高效的机制可能出现低效率或合理嫉妒。具体而言，比同龄人更损失厌恶或更不自信的学生会获得次优配置。
